notes: The articles on ʾêpāh and hîn are marked unrepresented because the ASV renders those nouns indefinitely (*of an ephah*, *of a hin*), and the single *the* of *the sixth part* / *the third part* is supplied for the ordinal substantive (rules 15, 29). The competing reading treats these as rule 29's fronting case (lūḥōt hā-ʾăbānîm → *the two tables of stone*), giving the written *the* to the rectum's article; it is rejected here because the ASV writes an indefinite article on the rectum rather than rendering it bare. This matches the chapter's treatment in 46.5, 46.7 and 46.11.
ḥuqqôt takes the supplied *by* as an adverbial accusative (rule 33) and ʿôlām is rendered attributively (rule 28).
